'''Purple mantis''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] invertebrates found on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and in the forests of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. These creatures had several small hearts and were extremely tough; a single mantis could withstand dozens of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] slashes or [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots before being [[Death/Legends|killed]].
